svg.title: Embeddings start as random numbers and get adjusted during training
svg.desc: An animation of a tiny model learning 2-number embeddings for 31 words. At the start every word sits at a random position. During training the words cat, dog, mouse, bird and fish drift together, and so do paris, rome, tokyo, france, italy, japan and city, while function words like the and is settle elsewhere.
svg.text: How embeddings are learned: random start, then nudged
Each dot is one word's 2 numbers (a real model has thousands of columns; 2 lets us draw them).
Trained for real on 18 tiny sentences by predicting nearby words. The model never sees the colors.
